name: THE LOOKOUT
note: Doc 109, THE LOOKOUT: 'At the foot of the path, in the tents. G3.' Doc 107: 'Meets every stranger at the foot of the ledge path, because every stranger is a claim jumper.' He stands at the foot of the zigzag path where the composition master stood him (room-51 operation 1). His tree, barks and GIVE lines are doc 109's, extracted; doc 49's ROOM 51 answers a wrong verb on him (errata 202). Barks in turn, the same in every reputation state: the Gulch has not heard of Thad (doc 107).
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: beside him, a step nearer the camera, on the camp's side and clear of the notice's stump, so the notice stays in view (doc 55 section 8: beside them, nobody hidden).

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: the pan across his chest like a shield, and its breath. Frame 2 is a look back over his shoulder up the path; frame 3 the pan raised to his chin. Frame 4 is talking, a palm out: 'Stop there.'
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, the gold pan across his chest · 1 breath · 2 a look back over his shoulder · 3 the pan raised to his chin, glaring over it · 4 talking, a palm out. Errata 263 (reference/final-look, reference/acted-directions-2): 5 reading the paper open in both hands · 6 the paper lowered, looking toward Thad · 7 the paper tucked in his shirt over his heart, his hand flat on it. Acted only (doc 95 rows 81 and 82).
sprite.figureHeightNote: The room's man at his feet (soles y 640): cut and snapped there by tools/art/interiors-people.py (errata 112's one level). The engine draws him at the room's man there, so he stands at the curve.

lines: You're late. Whatever you want, you're late for it.
I know what you are. Don't tell me. I know.
You're late again. We all are, but you're later.
